searchText: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/altair/light-client/p2p-interface.md > The gossip ForkDigestValue is determined based on `compute_fork_version(compute_epoch_at_slot(finality_update.attested_header.beacon.slot))`. --> attested header there are tests for this, btw. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/tests/formats/light_client/sync.md and, https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/tests/formats/light_client/data_collection.md (for the server side if you are locally collecting the LC data as a BN) Thanks <@881905303011086387> np. and also, keep in mind there can be slots without blocks. the situation you describe can happen not only in the first slot of a new fork. the tests are quite exhaustive and cover scenarios where `finalized_header`, `attested_header`, `fork_version_slot`, and `signature_slot` all come from four different forks. that way, it will still work even if there happens to be an emergency fork in some future where forks are not 8192-slot aligned (Altair for example also wasn't 8192 slot aligned) nice. I will try the tests.
